1Normal Internet Use
  • Your devices send a request
  • Your router passes it on
  • Your ISP routes it by public IP
  • It crosses the internet
  • It reaches the server
  • The server’s router receives it
  • It enters the server’s network
2Is VPN Safe?

Using a commercial app or another company’s VPN

  • Your traffic goes from home to the company
  • The company can easily intercept it
  • It can fake phishing links or show altered copies of the pages you request
  • …to collect the names, passwords, accounts and bank credentials you type
